file is relative to the active theme. Server processes .tt templates; data supplies JSON-encoded template variables only for .tt and raw has no effect for .tt. skipDefault=true skips default fallback except accounts without a branding package always use theme fallback. Null optional values omit; supplied empty strings remain and bool false/true send 0/1. Return exact string content (including empty/HTML/Unicode/zero-like text) or explicit null; missing data is a mismatch.

PR108 review 5725970479 on 11.138.0.19: when no file matches, the handler returns nothing, giving status 0 with null errors, so ApiErrorException::errors() is empty. Treat that exception as a missing file.

The source GET is x-readonly=true; effective form POST keeps arbitrary potentially private data out of URLs. data remains an unparsed raw string, including malformed, scalar, list or duplicate-key JSON-like text. No JSON serialization, input mode selection, filename-based omission, conflict guards, local templates, sanitization or HTML encoding/decoding occurs.
